text:
alice: Quick heads-up — seeing a reconciliation diff spike for billing this morning, tenant=acme, ~1.2k tokens double-counted.
ben: I saw that alert too. Suspect idempotency keys are getting dropped after compaction. Reproducer sketch:
ben: ```
{"event_id":"evt-123","tenant":"acme","idempotency_key":"id-789","tokens":120}
// compactor emits: {"event_id":"evt-123-compact","tenant":"acme","tokens":120}
```
dave: Oof. If compactor rewrites event_id but drops idempotency_key then dedupe won't catch it downstream.
carmen: Are these duplicates from immediate retries or late-arriving replayed events?
ben: Mix — most are late arrivals (retries/timeouts) that get compacted, then reprocessed by the reconciler, so credits get applied twice.
erin: Proposal: add a canonical_fingerprint that survives compaction (hash(tenant + request_root_id + nonces)). Also preserve original_idempotency in provenance.
dave: Rollout plan: (1) add canonical_fingerprint to envelope schema, (2) preserve idempotency_key through compactor transforms, (3) make reconciler prefer earliest event_ts when resolving conflicts. Minimal downtime.
alice: Action items: @carmen own schema change (1). @ben help update compactor to forward idempotency_key (2). @dave wire reconciler tweak and add an alert for >0.1% duplicate credits. :thumbsup:
carmen: I can do #1, ETA EOD tomorrow. Will open PR with schema migration notes.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: compactor-service v2.14 -> staging.
ben: Also adding metric `reconciler.duplicates.detected` and a debug log when duplicate_fingerprint != null.
erin: I'll file a follow-up ticket PLAT-987 to track backfill + audit queries (include sample SQL to find affected tenants).
alice: Thanks — sensible short-term fix. We'll schedule a post-mortem if the reconciler shows >5% impact in the next 24h.
